audit.why: Level chart in full (phases[N].side) and content (win[N]) agree row for row: Skill/Ornn/Ornn/Skill/Skill/Ornn/Ornn. 54.83% over 1844 games supports the Ornn-favoured tail. Mirror audit recorded 'No side or rating changed.'

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike and cooldown text named abilities but gave no numbers, so 'punish him when it's down' had nothing to count.
audit.why: Justice Punch 11/10/9/8/7s, Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14s, Searing Charge 14s, Call of the Forge God 140/120/100s are all in the kits.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into tldr, tradeGood, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0].d and spikes[0].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Volcanic Rupture grounds Justice Punch (Galio's only gap-closer), and Searing Charge knocks up ONLY on a terrain collision.
audit.why: Ornn Q carries the grounding flag; Galio E carries the dash flag. Ornn E text states the knockup is conditional on colliding with terrain. Both listed in missingInteractions (dash-denied, enemy-dash-deniable).
audit.corrected: Grounding and the terrain-collision condition written into tldr, winCon, tradeGood, report[5], dosFull[0].d, spikes[0].text.

audit.why: The punishable window is Shield of Durand at 18s rank 1 — without it his short-range body has no damage reduction.

edits.before: Bait his key tool — brittle-proc him on the Justice Punch cooldown and out-item the lane. Ornn wins the Justice Punch cooldown windows.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture grounds Justice Punch — deny his dash, then Searing Charge into the pillar and W-brittle the knockup for the proc.

edits.before: Brittle-proc him on the Justice Punch cooldown and out-item the lane. Track Justice Punch before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Drop Volcanic Rupture under him so Justice Punch cannot fire, E into that pillar for the knockup, then W-brittle and auto to detonate it.

edits.before: Galio wins by landing Justice Punch, denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Galio wins by landing Justice Punch, absorbing your E in Shield of Durand's charge, and out-trading your windows.

edits.before: Q the pillar behind Galio, E-dash through it for the knockup when his answer is down, and W-brittle the trade for the proc.
edits.after: Q the pillar behind Galio to ground Justice Punch, E into it for the knockup he cannot dash out of, then W-brittle to proc it.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch: 11s at rank 1, 7s maxed — his only gap-closer, and Volcanic Rupture grounds it. - Shield of Durand: 18s, 14s maxed — his taunt eats a raw E, so bait it first. - Call of the Forge God: 140s — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Galio's Justice Punch: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. When it is down — W-brittle + E knockup.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture grounds Justice Punch (11s/7s) — his gap-closer dies on your Q. E into the pillar: only terrain collision knocks up.

edits.before: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 11s at rank 1, 7s maxed — and Volcanic Rupture grounds it, so Q under him as he steps up.

edits.before: Second point in your combo lets you E into your own Q pillar for a knock-up that detonates Brittle — punish any step-up Galio takes to last-hit.
edits.after: Searing Charge (14s) into your own Volcanic Rupture pillar knocks up only on that terrain collision — and the pillar grounds his Justice Punch.
